Isle of Tiree · Inner Hebrides

Personally picked and hand crafted.

Cowrie shell necklaces, earrings and bracelets, made in small batches from shells gathered by hand on the west-facing beaches of a very small island.

Every shell in every piece was found, not ordered.

We walk the beaches of Tiree and pick each cowrie shell by hand — one at a time, only the whole ones. They are cleaned, drilled and strung onto fine chain in our workshop, so no two pieces are quite the same.

Beautifully handcrafted, quietly premium, and made to be worn every day rather than kept in a box.

Our story

We have personally selected these shells off the beaches of Tiree.

Tiree is a low, bright island at the western edge of the Hebrides, and its beaches are one of the few places in Britain where cowrie shells wash up whole. Finding them takes patience — you walk slowly, head down, and on a good afternoon you come home with a handful.

Everything we sell begins on one of those walks. The shells are rinsed, sorted by size, drilled by hand and strung onto chain at a workbench, not on a production line. It is slow, and that is the point: each piece keeps the marks of the beach it came from.

The result is jewellery that feels considered rather than mass-made — a premium, handcrafted keepsake from a very small island.
